(2) The scene cuts to the woman drinking the wine alongside a smiling young man wearing glasses and a dark graphic t-shirt in the same warm indoor setting. The woman tilts her head back to finish the drink while looking happy and relaxed. (3) Inside a dark karaoke room with colorful screen lighting, the woman performs energetic and exaggerated dance moves while holding a blue and red microphone. She lunges, spins, and waves her arms wildly, wearing her pink top and wide-leg jeans with heart cutouts. Several friends are partially visible in the background on leather sofas near a table cluttered with glasses and bottles. (4) The woman is in the passenger seat of a car at night, laughing uncontrollably and singing along with a man in glasses who is driving. The interior is dimly lit by streetlights, and her seatbelt is visible as she leans back and forth in excitement. (5) In a brightly lit domestic home environment, a young boy with spiky black hair sits at a white table focused on drawing with a marker. The woman leans her face close to his, looking sober and asking him a question while he maintains a serious, slightly annoyed expression before gesturing with his hand.
